```yaml
applyTo: '**/*.ts'
---

When reviewing any PRs which include *.ts files and use the following instructions.

Leverage the existing mcp tool azure-sdk-code-review to help review the PR if you can.

### Model Name

When Foo and FooAutoGenerated co-exist, this usually means we have duplicated names. Please comment duplicated names out to call out for a renaming.

```typescript
// Not recommended because of duplicated name
export model Foo {}
export model FooAutoGenerated {}
```

Or

```typescript
// Not recommended because of duplicated name
export model Foo {}
export model Foo_2 {}
```
